sections.text: Introduction

The 132 kv 
bus bar diff. pro. is designed for 
quick and selective tripping of a failure bus bar, the diff. prot. zone is stretched through the 132kv bus bar, the 132kv circuit breakers as well as 
bushings of 132kv feeders from bus bars to circuit breakers and from circuit breaker to 
current transformers.

The bus bar diff. prot. is respondent to faults of all types within 
zone, section and it, is respondent to 
 geometrical summary current of bus bar feeders and power transformers, when 
 fault occurs within prot zone, the summary (secondary ) current of short cir. 
 appears at the DIFF retinal element, when short cir is out of prot zone and as 
 well as at the rated loaded operation conditions, the current sum of diff. 
 organ is equal to zero

The first draft initialed 
& tested by eng. Mohamed Mostafa Abdel Gawad at 22 Aug 2004 at 
Samalout 
 500, approved by 
general director eng. 
 Ahmed Saeed
 Abd El Azeez MPIS ME zone coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet ... etc.
Ensure that Line isolation is done.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted and VT secondary circuits are opened before 
 injection.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Preliminary steps to Prepare for 
Relay Testing
Review technical reference material: Manufacturers manual

Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and 
compare it with the setting on the relay
Obtain outage for line protected by this relay

Check that the bus and line disconnect switches are opened and 
tagged

Inspect CT secondary circuits, the VT miniature circuit breakers (MCB`S) 
and all cabling supplying the relay

Use the station 
drawing to isolate the following:
 - Breaker trip coils
 - Breaker failure scheme associated with this relay
 - Disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this 
relay

items: This procedure is used to perform off load relay testing

 EEC designation

Check all external connections to the relay are in good 
 condition and check that the terminal block wires are tight
